gotchas: app.clickup.com can take 45-50 s to render the sign-in form or the workspace; a load that stays on the loader usually renders on a second load of https://app.clickup.com/.
Sign-in form: input[type=email], input[type=password], then button[type=submit]; the submit stays disabled until both fields are filled.
A new workspace can open a dialog with a Continue button on first load; close it before clicking Upgrade.

Upgrade (top bar) opens the plans page with Monthly/Yearly toggles and one Upgrade button per paid plan; the first one ([class*=plan] button:has-text("Upgrade") >> nth=0) opened the Unlimited card dialog.

The card form is Braintree hosted fields: three iframes whose titles contain 'card number', 'expiration' and 'cvv', holding #credit-card-number, #expiration and #cvv. Fill expiry first, then number, then CVV as the very next field.

Verified 2026-10-12 through the staging proxy with the public test card under a verification-only key: expiry, number and CVV filled (card_fields_verified). Stopped before the dialog's Upgrade button.
